content:
sarah.peopleops: Heads up — updating the manager checklist for elevations next week. Quick Qs?

anna-manager: Do we have guidance for promotions that span two teams? Can manager of origin set level or do we need both managers' sign-off?

mike-eng: And what about effective dates when someone transitions teams mid-month?

sarah.peopleops: Short answers: both managers need to sign for org moves; effective date usually first of next month unless payroll cutoff met. If move is immediate for operational reasons, tick the "expedite" box and we'll route to Finance.

lisa-ic: Any hard limits on comp deltas during elevation? Exec approval thresholds?

sarah.peopleops: Anything >15% increase or that puts comp > band_max requires compensation committee + Finance approval. Add market comps / salary survey notes in the packet.

anna-manager: Do we have a plain checklist I can paste into a 1:1?

sarah.peopleops: Yes — manager checklist to copy: 
```
1) Open Promotion Request form (Workday link)
2) Update job profile and summary of new scope (1 paragraph)
3) Provide 2 examples of impact + data if available
4) Complete calibration notes tab in the promotions spreadsheet
5) Get manager_of_origin + manager_of_destination sign-off (if applicable)
6) Director approval / comp recommendation
7) Submit to People Ops for comp sign-off and payroll scheduling
8) If >15% or band breach -> include finance justification and request comp committee review
```
Link to template: https://confluence.redwood/people/manager-elevations (use the "copy for team" macro).

mike-eng: How long does People Ops + Comp typically take once submitted?

sarah.peopleops: 3-5 business days for complete packets. If we need market data or restructuring approvals it can be 7-10. Use the checklist to avoid delays.

lisa-ic: Spot/urgent promotions — allowed?

sarah.peopleops: Off-cycle/spot promotions are allowed for retention/critical hires. Requirements: manager + People Ops + director sign-off, a short urgency rationale, and cadence note. We tag them as "off-cycle" so they appear on next calibration export.

anna-manager: What about retro pay if approval comes after payroll cutoff?

sarah.peopleops: Standard rule: effective date is first of next month. Retro pay only if approval is before payroll cutoff (we'll calculate in Finance). Exceptions are rare and require Finance sign-off.

hr-bot: Reminder: Promotion window for the next cycle opens 2026-02-01. Auto email sent on receipt of requests.

mike-eng: great — I'll start drafting rationale and examples. Thanks! :thumbsup: 

sarah.peopleops: Happy to review drafts — DM me and attach the draft packet.
